slots.name: World Cup titles
slots.sentence: Odermatt’s five overall World Cup titles place him level with Marc Girardelli in second place on the all-time list.

slots.name: Olympic medals
slots.sentence: The 28-year-old Odermatt also won three medals — two silvers and a bronze — at last season’s Milan Cortina Olympics , to go with his giant slalom gold four years earlier in Beijing.
